name: v2026.02.23
body: # Changes I'm excited to announce our first release of 2026. There has been _a lot_ of internal reorganization to standardize drivers and functionality across our various firmwares and devices: Zigbee, Thread, and Z-Wave now live under the same roof and can be built with the same tooling. # Beta firmwares We regularly publish beta firmwares for Zigbee and Thread for the ZBT-1, ZBT-2, and Yellow. If you'd like to participate and test out new features early, you can opt into beta updates by navigating to your device's respective integration and enabling the beta toggle: --- # Changes ## General - Our firmware builder has been entirely Dockerized and is now natively compatible with both ARM and x86-64 hosts. You can clone this repo test your own firmware tweaks in 30 seconds with [a single command](https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder?tab=readme-ov-file#building-with-docker)! ## Zigbee - Bump from Gecko SDK 4.4.5 to 4.5.0. This will be our last release built with the Gecko SDK, all future releases will be built with Simplicity SDK. - The network activity LED for the Yellow has been re-enabled. - A new feature is now enabled to allow ZHA to more quickly restore network routes on startup. ## Thread - Bump from Gecko SDK 4.5.0 to Simplicity SDK 2025.6.2. - The ZBT-2 LED now pulses during setup, before a Thread network has been joined. ## Z-Wave - The radio firmware for the ZWA-2 has been restructured and merged into this repository. ## New Contributors * @Szewcson made their first contribution in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/130 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/compare/v2025.11.24...v2026.02.23

name: v2026.01.11-beta2
body:
# Changes
I'm excited to announce the first release of 2026. There has been _a lot_ of internal reorganization to standardize LED functionality across Zigbee, Thread, and Zigbee router firmwares for the ZBT-2 and to prepare the codebase for the eventual migration from Silicon Labs Gecko SDK to Simplicity SDK.

<sup>(This is a re-release of [2026.01.11-beta1](https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/releases/tag/v2026.01.11-beta1) that fixes a few CI and metadata issues, nothing else has changed so I'm reusing the release notes from the prior release).</sup>

## General
- The firmware builder has been entirely Dockerized and is now natively compatible with both ARM and x86-64 hosts. You can clone this repo test your own firmware tweaks in 30 seconds with [a single command](https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder?tab=readme-ov-file#building-with-docker)!

## Zigbee
- A Zigbee router firmware for the ZBT-2! Try it out by flashing the GBL file below using the [OHF Device Toolbox for the ZBT-2](https://toolbox.openhomefoundation.org/home-assistant-connect-zbt-2/install/). Hold down the pinhole reset button on the back of the ZBT-2 to reset it and get it to join a new network.
- The network activity LED has been re-enabled for the Yellow.
- An experimental feature is now enabled to allow ZHA to quickly restore network routes on startup, 

## Thread
- OpenThread RCP firmware for all adapters has migrated from Gecko SDK 4.5.0 to the latest release of Simplicity SDK.
- The ZBT-2 LED now pulses during setup, before a network has been formed.

---

## What's Changed
* XNCP command: read chip info by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/121
* Merge stable into dev by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/131
* slsdk file for extension and debian image bump for CI by @Szewcson in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/130
* Switch to new URLs for SiLabs tools by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/132
* Create a tool to generate combined bootloader + application + tokens HEX by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/135
* Allow manually managing the route table by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/118
* Gecko SDK 4.5.0 by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/138
* Dual GPIO bootloader trigger by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/143
* Move drivers into dedicated SDK components by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/151
* Move all XNCP commands into components by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/152
* Port reset button component from stable to main by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/153
* Align LED behavior between OpenThread and Zigbee firmwares by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/154
* Drop Z-Wave source code by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/155
* Use Simplicity SDK v2025.6.2 for OpenThread RCP firmware by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/156
* Merge `stable` into `main` by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/157
* Fix Yellow Zigbee activity LED by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/158
* Set `PCLK_DIVIDER` instead of `DEFAULT_HF_CLOCK_SOURCE` for Yellow OT-RCP config by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/160
* Export a `sl_led`-compatible interface for the WS2812 API by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/161
* OpenThread: Use EUSART peripheral instead of USART for MG24 by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/162
* LED manager component and WS2812B temporal dithering by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/163
* Create factory HEX files out of GBL files by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/165
* Switch from 32-bit to 4×8-bit lookup table for WS2812 bit patterns by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/166
* Docker entrypoint by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/168
* Zigbee router firmware for ZBT-2 by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/164
* Swap build system from Makefiles to CMake + Ninja by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/169
* Tag containers when merging by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/170
* Ensure manifest generation runs even when cached containers are used by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/171
* Fix OpenThread version format for Simplicity SDK by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/172
* Fix latest OpenThread changelog entry by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/173

## New Contributors
* @Szewcson made their first contribution in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/130

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/compare/v2025.11.24...v2026.01.11-beta2

name: v2025.10.29 (beta)
body:
# Changes
This is the first beta firmware release and will be available for installation in Home Assistant Core 2025.11.0b0. To access it, enable beta firmware update switch in your adapter's respective hardware integration (it is disabled by default).

This release increases the UART RX buffer size to fix OTA issues encountered by Z2M users and also enables the reset button on the ZBT-2. If you're using ZHA, you can freely test the button and ZHA will recover your network the next time it starts up.

## What's Changed
* Increase `SL_IOSTREAM_USART_VCOM_RX_BUFFER_SIZE` from 32 to 128 bytes by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/139
* Reset button for ZBT-2 by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/137


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/compare/v2025.09.30...v2025.10.29-beta

name: v2025.09.17
body:
# Changes
This is a patch release incorporating a few small fixes:
1. The routing table size has been increased. This will help increase communication speed in certain network layouts when you control many devices at once.
2. Disable firmware group messages filtering. This allows the adapter to receive commands from arbitrary groups. Group commands with arbitrary group IDs are used by some scene controllers to distinguish button presses.

A new XNCP command has been added to identify the exact chip in use, to allow tailoring adapter settings at driver startup.

## What's Changed
* Bump the EmberZNet patch number to 7.4.4.1 by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/108
* Remove group packet filtering by replacing `sli_zigbee_am_multicast_member` by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/112
* Backport fixes from stable into dev by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/113
* Fix C flag definitions for some EZSP config options by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/117
* Increase routing table size by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/115
* Merge `main` into `stable` by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/123


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/compare/v2025.04.04...v2025.09.17

name: Build 2024.10.21 (Gecko SDK v4.4.4)
body:
# Information

This firmware release is built with the Silicon Labs Gecko SDK v4.4.4. There are no major changes or bugfixes in this release. New functionality includes the ability to rewrite the IEEE address of your Zigbee stick (allowing you to migrate the network multiple times).

---

## For developers
This release rewrites the firmware builder and moves all chip-specific customization directly into the YAML manifests, in addition to renaming the firmware types. This is a breaking change for all firmware types. Please see the changes to [the ZBT-1 manifest](https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/82/files#diff-223023eb892776526a20ebf517a471997dfa0424ff1c817f371b8674afd3dc87) for an example of how to migrate.

This release also introduces preliminary support for our XNCP custom commands. This is a work-in-progress and Zigbee software support will arrive over time. Do not rely on this command set to be stable, it will change in a future release.

## What's Changed
* Template projects by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/82
* Custom XNCP protocol commands by @puddly in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/57
* Add zap tooling to Docker container by @tl-sl in https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/pull/84

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder/compare/v2024.8.20...v2024.10.21
